fields.name: path
fields.description: The absolute path the released review was written to.

fields.name: delivered_at
fields.description: When the agent claimed the mail that told it the review was waiting.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the batch was opened, which is the first comment written into it.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When anything in it last moved.

fields.name: body
fields.description: What the author said about the work as a whole rather than about any one line, empty when they said nothing.

fields.name: open_threads
fields.description: How many of this review's comments nobody has settled. A released review with none left is finished. The verdict does not say so, because it records what the author concluded at the time and not what has happened since.

fields.name: external_login
fields.description: The forge login of whoever wrote a review mirrored from the forge, empty otherwise.

agent.v1.ReviewMessage.name: ReviewMessage
agent.v1.ReviewMessage.description: ReviewMessage is one thing said in a review thread.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The handle an edit of this message names it by.

fields.name: thread_id
fields.description: Which conversation it belongs to.

fields.name: author_kind
fields.description: Whether a person, an agent or someone on the forge wrote it.

fields.name: author_agent_id
fields.description: The agent that wrote it. Absent for the person reviewing, and cleared if that agent is deleted. author_kind says who wrote it, not this field.

fields.name: body
fields.description: What the author wrote.

fields.name: suggestion
fields.description: Replacement lines the author proposes for the thread's range. Empty for an ordinary comment. An agent applies these instead of reasoning about them.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was written.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When it was last edited.

fields.name: delivery
fields.description: How far this comment has got towards the agent reading it.

fields.name: sent_at
fields.description: When the person reviewing released this comment, empty while it is only written down.

fields.name: delivered_at
fields.description: When the agent claimed the doorbell raised for this comment, empty until it has.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: The review this message went out with, absent for an answer written by the agent under review, which belongs to no batch.

fields.name: round_id
fields.description: The round an addressed reply was taken of. Absent on every other message.

fields.name: forge
fields.description: The forge comment this message was mirrored from, absent for anything written in komrad.

fields.name: accepted_from
fields.description: The held forge message the person accepted this message as a copy of, absent on everything else.

agent.v1.ReviewRound.name: ReviewRound
agent.v1.ReviewRound.description: ReviewRound is one immutable snapshot of what a task's writer has written. A review is given against it. The snapshot is a commit rather than the worktree, so nothing a comment is pinned to can move underneath the person reading it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The handle a review or a viewed-file record names this round by.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: The task whose checkout the snapshot was taken of.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.description: Which round this is for its task, counting from one.

fields.name: base_sha
fields.description: The commit the agent's branch left its base at when the round was taken.

fields.name: snapshot_sha
fields.description: The commit the whole worktree was written out as, tracked and untracked alike.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the snapshot was taken, in RFC 3339.

agent.v1.ReviewThread.name: ReviewThread
agent.v1.ReviewThread.description: ReviewThread is one conversation pinned to a place in a round of a task's diff.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The handle a reply or a resolve names this thread by.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: The task whose diff the thread is pinned to.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: The batch this thread was opened as part of.

fields.name: round_id
fields.description: The round the thread is anchored to, which never moves.

fields.name: round_ordinal
fields.description: Which round that is, counting from one.

fields.name: base_sha
fields.description: The commit the old side of these line numbers was read against. This is the round's own base unless the diff was narrowed to an earlier round when the thread was written.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: Which file, relative to the checkout.

fields.name: old_start
fields.description: Where the range begins on the old side of the diff, counting from one.

fields.name: old_end
fields.description: Where it ends on the old side, inclusive.

fields.name: new_start
fields.description: Where the range begins on the new side.

fields.name: new_end
fields.description: Where it ends on the new side, inclusive.

fields.name: quoted_lines
fields.description: The diff lines the thread was written against, each keeping its leading marker.

fields.name: resolved_at
fields.description: When the person reviewing settled this thread. Empty while it is still owed an answer. Settling is separate from whether the code under the thread has moved, and settling decides whether the thread still asks for something.

fields.name: unread_by_human
fields.description: Whether the agent has replied since the person reviewing last looked.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: Everything said in the thread, oldest first.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the thread was opened.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When anything in it last moved.

fields.name: mirrors_forge
fields.description: Whether the thread mirrors one on the pull request, where a reply is public.

fields.name: forge_replies
fields.description: What komrad has drafted, posted or failed to post on the forge thread, oldest first. Only the person reviewing is shown these.

agent.v1.ReviewThreadInContext.name: ReviewThreadInContext
agent.v1.ReviewThreadInContext.description: ReviewThreadInContext is one thread of a released review, with the code it was written about drawn from the round's snapshot.

fields.name: thread
fields.description: The thread as list_review_threads renders it, holding only the messages that went out with this review.

fields.name: context
fields.description: The snapshot's lines around the thread's range, each prefixed with its line number and ">>" on the lines the thread is about. Empty when the snapshot cannot be read, in which case the thread's quoted_lines are what there is.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The words to search for in each document's newest version, matched whole and stemmed. A quoted phrase matches in order, and a leading minus excludes a word.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The agent whose documents to search, by id. Unset searches every agent's, archived agents included.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of documents to search, by name. Unset searches every type.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: How many documents to return across `matches` and `near`. Zero returns up to fifty.

fields.name: matches
fields.description: The documents that contain every word, best match first.

fields.name: near
fields.description: The documents that contain a word only inside a longer word, closest first.

agent.v1.SearchHit.name: SearchHit
agent.v1.SearchHit.description: SearchHit is one turn of a transcript that matched a search.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The id of the agent whose transcript holds the turn.

fields.name: snippet
fields.description: The turn's text around the match, with the match marked.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The agent's name.

fields.name: archived
fields.description: Whether the agent is archived. Search includes archived agents.

fields.name: score
fields.description: How well the turn matched. Zero when the hits are ordered by time.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: The turn's position in the transcript, counting from one.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Who wrote the turn: the agent, or whoever prompted it.

fields.name: content_offset
fields.description: The byte offset of the turn in the whole transcript, for reading the text around it.

fields.name: content_length
fields.description: How many bytes the turn runs to from `content_offset`.

fields.name: spoken_at
fields.description: When the turn was written. Unset when the CLI's log was gone before komrad read the time.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The words to search for, matched whole and stemmed. A quoted phrase matches in order, a leading minus excludes a word, and qualifiers narrow the search.

fields.name: pagination
fields.description: The page to read. One cursor pages through `matches` and `near` together.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The agent whose transcript to search, by id. Unset searches the caller's own, unless a qualifier names other agents.

fields.name: matches
fields.description: The turns that contain the words, in the order the query asked for.

fields.name: near
fields.description: The turns that contain the letters only inside other text, such as a word inside a path. They are ranked by how closely the letters match.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.description: The cursor for the next page of both lists. Unset on the last page.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The agent to send to, by id or by the name of a live agent.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The mail's text. It must say who is asking and what they want.

fields.name: reply_to
fields.description: The id of the mail this one answers, so the two read as a thread.

fields.name: mail
fields.description: The mail as sent.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Why the recipient will not read the mail soon. Unset when the recipient is running.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Which thread to settle or reopen.

fields.name: resolved
fields.description: Whether the thread is settled. Unsetting it reopens the thread, as a person does when the answer was not the end of it.

fields.name: thread
fields.description: The thread as it now stands.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow whose orchestrator to bring back, or to start if it has never had one.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The opening briefing a fresh orchestrator is launched with, blank for komrad's own.

fields.name: agent
fields.description: The orchestrator, with a pane to talk to.

agent.v1.Turn.name: Turn
agent.v1.Turn.description: Turn is one turn of an agent's transcript.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Who wrote the turn: the agent, or whoever prompted it.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: The turn's position in the transcript, counting from one.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The turn's text. When `truncated` is set, only the end of it.

fields.name: truncated
fields.description: Whether the start of the text was cut to fit `max_bytes`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Which agent to rename.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The new name, as the panel lists it. It may not contain spaces, colons, dots, slashes or control characters.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The document to rewrite, by id. Unset creates a document.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The document's title.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The name of the document's type, one `list_document_types` returns.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The document's text, in markdown.

fields.name: path
fields.description: A markdown file on the machine komrad runs on. A relative path starts at the writing agent's checkout.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The document's `version` when last read. Required on a rewrite.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The agent to write the document for, by id. An agent may name only itself.

fields.name: document
fields.description: The document as written, without its text.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The document type to rewrite, by id. Unset creates a document type.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The document type's name. Renaming a type renames it on its documents too.

fields.name: context
fields.description: The markdown an agent reads before writing a document of this type.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The document type's `version` when last read. Required on a rewrite.

fields.name: document_type
fields.description: The document type as written.

fields.name: config
fields.description: The configuration in force, keyed as in the config file, with defaults filled in and connection strings redacted.

fields.name: config_error
fields.description: Why the person's config file failed to parse. Unset when it parsed. When set, `config` holds the defaults.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The build version of the server.

doctor.v1.Finding.name: Finding
doctor.v1.Finding.description: Finding is the result of one doctor check.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The check's name, such as `database` or `tmux shell`.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the check is for, in one sentence.

fields.name: status
fields.description: How the check came out: `ok`, `warn`, `fail` or `skip`.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: What the check found, such as a version or a path. Empty when there is nothing to report.

fields.name: code
fields.description: A stable code for the problem, such as `db_unreachable`. Empty when nothing went wrong.

fields.name: error
fields.description: The problem, as the check worded it. Empty when nothing went wrong.

fields.name: fix
fields.description: What to do about the problem. Empty when there is nothing to do.

fields.name: findings
fields.description: Every check, in the order it ran.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: The findings counted by status.

doctor.v1.Summary.name: Summary
doctor.v1.Summary.description: Summary counts the findings of a doctor run by status.

fields.name: ok
fields.description: How many checks passed.

fields.name: warn
fields.description: How many checks passed with a warning.

fields.name: fail
fields.description: How many checks failed.

fields.name: skip
fields.description: How many checks were skipped because a check they need did not pass.

fields.name: total
fields.description: How many checks there are in all.

fields.name: healthy
fields.description: Whether no check failed.

fields.name: checks
fields.description: One check for each connection, in the order `list_forges` returns them.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The host to disconnect.

forge.v1.Forge.name: Forge
forge.v1.Forge.description: Forge is komrad's connection to one forge host and the credential komrad uses there.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The connection's id.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The kind of forge the host runs, `github` or `gitlab`.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The host that git remotes name, such as `github.com`.

fields.name: api_url
fields.description: The address of an enterprise host's API. Empty for the public forge.

fields.name: method
fields.description: How the credential was given, `token` or `github_app`.

fields.name: login
fields.description: The account the forge says the credential belongs to, a user login or an App's name.

fields.name: verified_at
fields.description: When the forge last accepted the credential, in RFC 3339. Unset once the forge refuses it.

fields.name: has_credential
fields.description: Whether this machine still has the credential. A `token` connection needs its token file, and a `github_app` connection always has its credential.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the connection was created, in RFC 3339.

forge.v1.ForgeCheck.name: ForgeCheck
forge.v1.ForgeCheck.description: ForgeCheck is what one forge said about komrad's credential.

fields.name: forge
fields.description: The connection checked.

fields.name: problem
fields.description: What the forge said was wrong. Empty when the forge accepted the credential.

fields.name: problem_kind
fields.description: The kind of problem, `refused`, `no_credential` or `unreachable`. Empty when there is none.

forge.v1.ForgePullRequest.name: ForgePullRequest
forge.v1.ForgePullRequest.description: ForgePullRequest is a pull request as the forge describes it, read live and not kept.

fields.name: forge
fields.description: The forge the pull request is on, such as `github`.

fields.name: provider_id
fields.description: The forge's own stable id for the pull request, such as GitHub's `node_id`.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The pull request's web address.

fields.name: repository_url
fields.description: The web address of the repository the pull request merges into.

fields.name: head_repository_url
fields.description: The web address of the repository the pull request's branch is in. Empty when the forge no longer has that repository.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The pull request's number, unique within its repository.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The pull request's title.

fields.name: head_branch
fields.description: The branch the pull request merges from.

fields.name: head_sha
fields.description: The commit at the tip of the pull request's branch.

fields.name: base_branch
fields.description: The branch the pull request merges into.

fields.name: base_sha
fields.description: The commit at the tip of the branch the pull request merges into.

fields.name: draft
fields.description: Whether the pull request is a draft.

fields.name: state
fields.description: The state the forge reports, `OPEN`, `CLOSED` or `MERGED`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the pull request was opened, in RFC 3339.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the pull request last changed on the forge, in RFC 3339.

fields.name: merged_at
fields.description: When the pull request merged, in RFC 3339. Unset until the pull request merges.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: When the pull request closed, in RFC 3339, merged or not. Unset while the pull request is open.

fields.name: remote_url
fields.description: The repository's git remote, such as `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` or `https://github.com/owner/repo`. The remote's host picks the forge connection.

fields.name: branch
fields.description: The branch whose pull requests to list, in any state. Empty lists the repository's open pull requests.

fields.name: pagination
fields.description: The page to read. The page size defaults to twenty and is at most a hundred.

fields.name: pull_requests
fields.description: One page of pull requests, in the forge's order.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.description: The cursor for the next page. Unset on the last page.

fields.name: forges
fields.description: Every connection, by host.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The pull request to merge, by web address. The address's host picks the forge connection.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The pull request to ask for reviews on, by web address. The address's host picks the forge connection.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The pull request to change, by web address. The address's host picks the forge connection.

fields.name: head_sha
fields.description: The head commit the caller expects. The forge refuses to turn auto-merge on once the branch has moved past it. Empty accepts any head.

fields.name: on
fields.description: Whether the pull request merges by itself once its checks and reviews pass.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The pull request to change, by web address. The address's host picks the forge connection.

fields.name: draft
fields.description: Whether the pull request is a draft. False marks the pull request ready for review.

hook.v1.Hook.name: Hook
hook.v1.Hook.description: Hook is a script in the hooks directory.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The hook's file name in the hooks directory. A workflow names the hook by it.

fields.name: executable
fields.description: Whether the file is executable. The hook cannot run until it is.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The description from the hook's header comments.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description: How long the hook may run. The header can shorten the `hooks.timeout` setting but not lengthen it.

fields.name: header_problems
fields.description: The header lines that could not be read. Each one leaves its setting at the default.

fields.name: hooks
fields.description: Every file in the hooks directory, executable or not.

fields.name: trace_id
fields.description: The trace id to read, from a failed call or from `list_recent_traces`.

fields.name: lines
fields.description: Every line written under the trace id, in the order they were written.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The agent whose log sources to list, by id.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: The server log first, then each hook run the agent recorded, newest first.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: How many of the newest traces to list. Zero lists twenty.

fields.name: traces
fields.description: The newest traces in the log, oldest first.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: The task whose log sources to list, by id.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Each hook run recorded on the task, by the task or any agent on it, newest first.

log.v1.LogLine.name: LogLine
log.v1.LogLine.description: LogLine is one line of the server's log.

fields.name: time
fields.description: When the line was written, in RFC 3339.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The line's severity, such as `INFO` or `ERROR`.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The line's message.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: The line's other fields, under the keys the log gives them.

log.v1.LogSource.name: LogSource
log.v1.LogSource.description: LogSource is one log an agent's lines can be read from: the server log, or one hook run.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The source's id, to pass as `source` to `read_agent_logs`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The source's name, such as `service` or `003 agent.pre-launch setup`.

fields.name: run
fields.description: The number of the hook run. Unset for the server log.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The id of the agent that recorded the hook run. Empty for the server log.

fields.name: failed
fields.description: Whether the hook run failed. Set only on a task's log sources.

fields.name: agent_ids
fields.description: The agents whose log lines to read, by id.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: The `cursor` from the previous response. Empty reads the newest lines.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: The most lines to return. Zero returns up to 200.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The log source to read, by the id `list_agent_log_sources` returns. Empty reads the server log. A hook run's source takes exactly one agent.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: A Go regular expression each line must match. Empty matches every line. Only the last 64 MB of the source is searched.

fields.name: lines
fields.description: The lines about any of the agents, oldest first, as the log wrote them.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: The cursor to pass back to read only lines written after these.

fields.name: reset
fields.description: Whether the log started over since the cursor. The lines before the reset are gone.

fields.name: more
fields.description: Whether more lines remain past the cursor, which another call returns at once.

log.v1.TraceSummary.name: TraceSummary
log.v1.TraceSummary.description: TraceSummary is one trace in the server's log.

fields.name: trace_id
fields.description: The trace's id.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: When the trace's first line was written, in RFC 3339.

fields.name: what
fields.description: The RPC method or loop the trace belongs to. Empty when no line names one.

fields.name: lines
fields.description: How many lines the log has under the trace.

pagination.v1.Pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.v1.Pagination.description: Pagination selects one page of a listing.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: How many records to return. The server caps the value, and picks one when unset.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: The `next_page_token` from the previous response. Unset to start from the first page.

fields.name: repository_url
fields.description: The repository the pull requests target, as a git remote spells it or as the canonical address komrad stores.

fields.name: head_branch
fields.description: The branch the pull requests were opened from. When empty, every pull request stored for the repository is listed.

fields.name: pagination
fields.description: Which page to read and how many to a page, twenty when unset and at most a hundred.

fields.name: pull_requests
fields.description: One page of pull requests, unfinished ones first and each group newest opened first. An agent's row on the branch shows the first one.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.description: The token for the page after this one, unset on the last.

pullrequest.v1.MergeReadiness.name: MergeReadiness
pullrequest.v1.MergeReadiness.description: MergeReadiness shows how close a pull request is to merging, as komrad reports it for its head.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Where the forge says the reviews stand.

fields.name: checks
fields.description: Where the checks on the head stand, unspecified when the forge last answered for an older head.

fields.name: mergeability
fields.description: Where the forge says it stands against its base and rules. While the forge recomputes, this holds the last answer it gave for the same head.

fields.name: mergeability_unconfirmed
fields.description: True when mergeability is the last answer for this head rather than the latest read.

fields.name: auto_merge
fields.description: Whether the forge says it will merge on its own once its checks and reviews pass.

fields.name: auto_mergeable
fields.description: Whether the forge would let komrad turn auto-merge on now. It refuses for a draft, for a pull request with nothing left to wait for, and for a repository that does not allow it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The handle komrad keys the row by.

fields.name: forge
fields.description: Which forge it lives on, such as github.

fields.name: provider_id
fields.description: The forge's own stable identifier, such as GitHub's node_id.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The web address a person opens.

fields.name: repository_url
fields.description: The canonical address of the repository it targets.

fields.name: head_repository_url
fields.description: The canonical address of the repository its branch lives in, empty when the forge no longer has it.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The number the forge shows a person. Numbers are per repository.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title as the forge has it.

fields.name: head_branch
fields.description: The branch the pull request was opened from.

fields.name: head_sha
fields.description: The commit at the tip of that branch when last read.

fields.name: base_branch
fields.description: The branch it targets.

fields.name: base_sha
fields.description: The commit the target branch was at when last read.

fields.name: draft
fields.description: Whether the forge marks it a draft.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Where it stands, decided from the stored row.

fields.name: opened_at
fields.description: When it was opened on the forge, in RFC 3339.

fields.name: changed_at
fields.description: When the forge last saw it change, in RFC 3339.

fields.name: merged_at
fields.description: When it merged, in RFC 3339, unset while it has not.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: When it closed, in RFC 3339. Unset while it is open. A merged pull request carries it too.

fields.name: merge_readiness
fields.description: Whether the forge would merge it: its reviews, checks, mergeability and auto-merge.

fields.name: author
fields.description: The login of whoever opened it, empty when the forge no longer has that account.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The description as the forge has it, empty when none was written.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Which schedule to hide, leaving the agents it already launched running.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What to list it as. It also becomes the title of each agent it launches.

fields.name: cron
fields.description: When to fire, as five whitespace-separated fields.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Which clock to read that against, blank for the machine's own.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: False to write the schedule down without arming it.

fields.name: hide_agents
fields.description: True to start the task each launch works on hidden from the panel's sidebar, ignored by an orchestrator schedule.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The opening prompt each launch is given, or the mail an orchestrator is sent.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: Start a task in this workflow. Its writer inherits the workflow's cwd and flags.

fields.name: orchestrator_agent_id
fields.description: Mail the prompt to this orchestrator.

fields.name: schedule
fields.description: The schedule as recorded, which has fired nothing yet.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Which archived schedule to remove for good.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Which schedule to read.

fields.name: schedule
fields.description: The schedule, with its prompt whole rather than cut to its opening.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Which schedule's firings to read.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: How many of the newest firings to return, twenty when unset.

fields.name: runs
fields.description: The firings on record, newest first.

fields.name: pagination
fields.description: Where to carry on from.

fields.name: view

values.name: MERGEABILITY_CLEAN
values.description: The forge would merge it now.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_UNSTABLE
values.description: Its checks are not all passing.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_BLOCKED
values.description: A branch rule is unmet, such as a required review.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_BEHIND
values.description: The base has moved past the branch.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_CONFLICTING
values.description: The branch no longer merges cleanly into its base.

pullrequest.v1.PullRequestState.name: PullRequestState
pullrequest.v1.PullRequestState.description: PullRequestState names where a stored pull request stands. The server decides it from the pull request's stamps, its draft flag, the checks on its head, its mergeability and the forge's review decision, finished first.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_UNREAD
values.description: The repository has not been read yet, so nothing is known.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_NONE
values.description: The repository has been read and nothing was opened from the branch.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_OPEN
values.description: Open with no review decision that settles it.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_APPROVED
values.description: Open and the forge would merge it now: its rules on reviews and checks are met and the branch is level with its base.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_CHANGES_REQUESTED
values.description: Open with a reviewer asking for changes.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_DRAFT
values.description: Still a draft, whatever its reviews say.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_MERGED
values.description: Merged.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_CLOSED
values.description: Closed without merging.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_FAILING
values.description: Open with a failing check on its head, whatever its reviews say.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_APPROVED_WAITING
values.description: Approved on the forge but not yet mergeable: its branch is behind or a branch rule is unmet.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_CONFLICTING
values.description: Open and no longer merging cleanly into its base, whatever its reviews say.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_CHECKS_RUNNING
values.description: Open with checks still running on its head and no change request.

values.name: PULL_REQUEST_STATE_REREVIEW_REQUESTED
values.description: Open with every reviewer who asked for changes asked to review again.

pullrequest.v1.ReviewDecision.name: ReviewDecision
pullrequest.v1.ReviewDecision.description: ReviewDecision is the forge's statement of where a pull request's reviews stand.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_NONE
values.description: The forge has said nothing about the reviews.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_PENDING
values.description: A review the forge requires that nobody has given.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_APPROVED
values.description: The forge counts the pull request as approved.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_CHANGES_REQUESTED
values.description: A reviewer is asking for changes.

values.name: REVIEW_DECISION_REREVIEW_REQUESTED
values.description: Every reviewer who asked for changes has been asked to review again.

schedule.v1.ScheduleKind.name: ScheduleKind
schedule.v1.ScheduleKind.description: ScheduleKind is what a schedule does each time it fires.

values.name: SCHEDULE_KIND_ORCHESTRATOR
values.description: Mails the prompt to an orchestrator that is already running.

values.name: SCHEDULE_KIND_TASK
values.description: Starts a new task in the workflow, its writer given the prompt.

schedule.v1.ScheduleRunState.name: ScheduleRunState
schedule.v1.ScheduleRunState.description: ScheduleRunState names the state River holds a firing's job in.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_AVAILABLE
values.description: Waiting for a worker to pick it up.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_PENDING
values.description: Held back from running until something releases it.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_SCHEDULED
values.description: Queued to become available at a later time.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_RUNNING
values.description: Being worked right now.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_RETRYABLE
values.description: Failed an attempt and waiting to try again.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_COMPLETED
values.description: Launched its agent or delivered its mail.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_CANCELLED
values.description: Skipped on purpose, with the reason in its message.

values.name: SCHEDULE_RUN_STATE_DISCARDED
values.description: Ran out of attempts, with the last error in its message.

task.v1.Sequence.name: Sequence
task.v1.Sequence.description: Sequence is a git operation stopped part way in a task's checkout.

values.name: SEQUENCE_NONE
values.description: No git operation is stopped part way.

values.name: SEQUENCE_REBASE
values.description: A rebase stopped on a commit it could not replay.

values.name: SEQUENCE_AM
values.description: A `git am` stopped on a patch it could not apply.

values.name: SEQUENCE_MERGE
values.description: A merge stopped on conflicts.

values.name: SEQUENCE_CHERRY_PICK
values.description: A cherry-pick stopped on conflicts or paused between commits.

values.name: SEQUENCE_REVERT
values.description: A revert stopped on conflicts or paused between commits.

view.v1.View.name: View
view.v1.View.description: View is how much of each record a listing returns.

values.name: VIEW_SUMMARY
values.description: Long text is cut to its opening, and each record says which fields were cut.

values.name: VIEW_FULL
values.description: Every field in full, however long.

worktree.v1.WorktreeFate.name: WorktreeFate
worktree.v1.WorktreeFate.description: WorktreeFate is what removes a worktree directory.

values.name: WORKTREE_FATE_UNOWNED
values.description: No task owns the directory. `remove_unowned_worktrees` removes it.

values.name: WORKTREE_FATE_ARCHIVED
values.description: The directory's task is archived. Deleting the task removes it.

values.name: WORKTREE_FATE_LIVE
values.description: The directory's task is live. Nothing removes it.

values.name: WORKTREE_FATE_DELETING
values.description: The directory's task is being deleted, which removes the directory.
